content.short: EulerDebt is a secondary marketplace for trading Euler vault deposit tokens peer-to-peer.
content.description: EulerDebt is a secondary marketplace for Euler vault deposit tokens, letting holders trade positions peer-to-peer and access liquidity when a vault itself cannot immediately return funds. That matters most during high utilisation, when depositors can be temporarily unable to withdraw. It is active on Plasma.
content.meta: EulerDebt is a peer-to-peer secondary marketplace for Euler vault deposit tokens, active on Plasma.
